step_009: save with one request, POST /wp-comments-post.php, in place of 10 GUI steps (step_000 to step_009).
  sign-in: the replaying browser's own session; form read again from /?p=1
  fields: 2 form_default, 4 param, 1 submitter
  run values: comment={comment}, author={author}, email={email}, url={url}
  accepted when: HTTP [302] and the response matches '/.*?p=\\d+.*?unapproved=\\d+.*?moderation\\-hash=[^&#\\s]+'
  record check after: 4 effect(s) copied from the save step
  right record (subject_name): the request sends {comment} in comment and the record check selects comment = {comment}
  the form's own script runs before each save, in a scratch page with writes blocked, on the run's values: inline script, script http://127.0.0.1:9664/wp-includes/blocks/navigation/view.min.js?ver=6.6.2, script http://127.0.0.1:9664/wp-includes/js/comment-reply.min.js?ver=6.6.2, script http://127.0.0.1:9664/wp-includes/js/dist/vendor/wp-polyfill-importmap.min.js?ver=1.8.2
  screen-only checks, not repeated: ['step_000: region_stable', 'step_002: region_stable', 'step_004: region_stable', 'step_006: region_stable']
  if the form or a check differs at run time, the GUI steps run instead
